using namespace std;
const int N=505;
long long dp[N],f[N],d[N][N],fd[N][N],C[N][N];
int n,i,M,m,j,k;
int main()
{
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> n >> m >> M;
    f[0]=1;
    for(i=0;i<=n;++i)
    {
        C[i][0]=C[i][i]=1;
        for(j=1;j<i;++j)
            C[i][j]=(C[i-1][j]+C[i-1][j-1])%M;
    }
    for(i=1;i<=n;++i)
        for(j=1;j<=i;++j)
        {

            int s=0;
            for(k=1;k<=i;++k)
                s+=abs(k-j);
            dp[i]=(dp[i]+dp[j-1]*f[i-j]%M*C[i-1][j-1]%M*(i+1)+f[j-1]*dp[i-j]%M*C[i-1][j-1]%M*(i+1)+s*f[j-1]%M*f[i-j]%M*C[i-1][j-1])%M;
        }
    fd[0][0]=1;
    for(i=1;i<=n;++i)
        for(j=0;j<=min(m,i);++j)
        {
            fd[i][j]=fd[i-1][j];
            d[i][j]=d[i-1][j];
            for(k=1;k<=j;++k)
            {
                long long prev_fd = (i-k-1>=0)?fd[i-k-1][j-k]:1;
                long long prev_d = (i-k-1>=0)?d[i-k-1][j-k]:0;
                fd[i][j]=(fd[i][j]+(prev_fd)*f[k]%M*C[j][k])%M;
                d[i][j]=(d[i][j]+((prev_fd)*dp[k]+prev_d*f[k])%M*C[j][k])%M;
            }
        }
    cout<<(d[n][m]%M+M)%M;
}
